reviews.title: Better than Britta as a starting base water for remineralising water for coffee
reviews.body: Best filter vs Britta, which is the other water filter I have used.This filter gets TDS down to zero which is great and removes the tap water taste. For the Britta filter, it also significantly removes the tap water taste but does not reduce TDS as much. This may not be an issue because all you want to do is to make tap water taste better.For my purpose, I need a very low TDS to remineralise water (using third wave water) to make coffee. Thus this filter is much better for that purpose.Downside is that this is much slower than the Britta so you should really buy the filter / system fit for your purpose.
reviews.author: JH

reviews.title: Great product always
reviews.body: I am a repeat customer for 5 years now & i have it for home use & office use as I do.I do not live in the US. for all the other reviews where they say it's bad, i think it's the water supply in their area issue. i faced similar issues at a different work location where the water was just weird tasting even after filtering. Don't forget the pipes that transport it do age & have dirt collected
reviews.author: Nancy T.

reviews.title: great drinking water without the plastic bottles
reviews.body: Brought my ZW from the USA when we moved to Singapore last year. We ran out of the filter elements a few months ago, but forunately able to order through Amazon. Although the tap water in Singapore is good, the filter removes the "stale taste" of tap water ...for the lack of better word. Now we have RO quality drinking water without all the plastic bottles.
